statement: Measurement- and resource-oriented contributions of exactly the proposed kind appear repeatedly in this neighbourhood: SituatedQA introduces an open-retrieval QA dataset requiring the correct answer given temporal or geographical context, motivated by the static paradigm misrepresenting practical performance; a regulatory retrieval study motivates itself by the claim that behaviour on narrow regulatory corpora remains understudied and delivers a benchmark plus the first systematic sparse/dense/hybrid comparison; and the legal work introduces a benchmark encoding temporal validity.

evidence.quote: an open-retrieval QA dataset where systems must produce the correct answer to a question given the temporal or geographical context
their behaviour on narrow financial corpora such as regulatory and procedural documents remains understudied
a new benchmark that encodes temporal validity
